description: The XmlSerializer class provides methods for serializing Java objects into XML and deserializing XML back into Java objects. It supports various standard Java types, collections, maps, and specific OFBiz types such as GenericValue and GenericPK, using custom XML formats or byte encoding for complex objects. It also includes deprecated notes and cautionary comments regarding security and database consistency.

classes.name: XmlSerializer
classes.description: A utility class for serializing Java objects to XML and deserializing XML back to Java objects. Supports various data types and complex objects, with both standard and custom serialization strategies.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Java object into an XML string representation.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a Java object from an XML string, with an optional delegator for resolving specific object types.

methods.name: serializeSingle
methods.description: Serializes an individual Java object into an XML element, handling various data types and collections.

methods.name: serializeCustom
methods.description: Handles the serialization of objects implementing Serializable via byte array encoding.

methods.name: makeElement
methods.description: Creates an XML element with a specified name and value, handling null values appropriately.

methods.name: deserializeSingle
methods.description: Deserializes an XML element back into a Java object, supporting standard types, collections, maps, and references to OFBiz types.

methods.name: deserializeCustom
methods.description: Handles deserialization of custom-encoded objects stored as hexadecimal byte strings.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Provides and caches the DateFormat used for serializing/deserializing java.util.Date objects.
